description.fun: Togepi is a bundle of joy still wearing its eggshell. It's said to soak up the happiness of kind people, store it in its shell and share it with whoever needs it, so it's seen as a sign of good luck. It turned up in Hey You, Pikachu! almost a year before Gold and Silver, the first Generation 2 Pokémon in a video game.
description.guide: A small baby Pokémon that keeps living inside its patterned eggshell after hatching. It was a Normal type until Generation 6 and is now a Fairy type. It is said to absorb and share the happiness of kind people, and evolves into Togetic and then Togekiss.
description.tagline: A lucky baby still in its shell, full of borrowed happiness

description.fun: Togetic can sense kindness, and flies around the world looking for pure-hearted people to shower with a glowing down called 'joy dust'. Around unkind people it loses heart and its energy fades. It floats without flapping its wings, held up by a power nobody quite understands.
description.guide: A small, angelic Pokémon of the Fairy and Flying types (Normal and Flying before Generation 6), evolved from Togepi. It senses kindness and shares happiness with pure-hearted people, and can float without flapping its wings. A Shiny Stone evolves it into Togekiss.
description.tagline: Seeks out kind hearts and showers them with joy dust

description.fun: Togekiss only shows up in peaceful places and has never been seen anywhere near conflict, so sightings have become rare. It has appeared on good-luck charms since ancient times and is said to bring blessings just by existing, though it can still throw an Aura Sphere when it has to. Its name pairs toge, Japanese for 'spike', with a kiss.
description.guide: A white, bird-like Pokémon of the Fairy and Flying types, introduced in Generation 4 as Togetic's evolution. Long seen as a bringer of blessings, it appears only in peaceful places. It evolves from Togetic with a Shiny Stone.
description.tagline: Appears only where there's peace, and brings blessings

note.text: Togepi is a baby Pokémon, one of only three introduced alongside the Pokémon they grow into (with Riolu and Toxel). It evolves once it's very friendly with its Trainer.
